pieces.name: Bias binding (neckline + armholes)
pieces.cut: cut 1 strip(s) 1231 x 25 mm ON THE BIAS (45° to the grain), join end to end (total 1231 mm = edge 1211 mm + overlap), press in half, wrap the edge and trim the excess

pieces.name: Neck/Front Tie (ön bağ)
pieces.cut: cut 2 rectangle(s) 80 x 380 mm (finished 25 x 350 mm), attach at the front neckline/centre front and knot into a bow

pieces.name: Shirred Yoke Panel (büzgü yaka panosu)
pieces.cut: cut 1 rectangle(s) 960 x 160 mm (join to a 930 mm flat top edge that gathers down to 465 mm), gathered shirred at the neckline

pieces.name: Ruffled Strap (fırfırlı askı)
pieces.cut: cut 2 rectangle(s) 74 x 338 mm (finished 22 mm wide, gathered down to a 140 mm strap), each gathers from the front shoulder over to the back
